question: Read the attached Statement of Work #4. What is the LIABILITY CAP and what carve-outs (if any) apply? Be precise about which Sections are uncapped.
expected_answer: Liability is capped at 6 months of fees paid, EXCEPT that liability arising from Sections 3.1, 5.2 is uncapped.
forbidden_answers: Liability is capped at 6 months of fees paid.

metadata.footnote_text: Notwithstanding Section 10.1, liability arising from Sections 3.1, 5.2 shall be uncapped.
metadata.expected_failure_mode: Model reads the body clause and ignores the 6pt footnote, missing the material carve-out / exception.
